title: ruellia nudiflora var. occidentalis
intro: Ruellia nudiflora var. occidentalis, commonly known as Mexican petunia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Ruellia nudiflora var. occidentalis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
